message.content:
The most‑visited market in New York City is generally considered to be **Union Square Greenmarket**.  
According to the city’s own reports, it attracts roughly **1.5 million visitors each year** (about 100,000–120,000 per week).  

If you’re looking at all types of markets—including indoor food halls—then **Chelsea Market** is another top contender, drawing close to **2 million visitors annually**.
